context.validated_for: uncached long-context retrieval and sustained visible generation

caveats: Validated on one RTX 5060 Ti 16GB with IQ3_M and q8 KV at 64K. The direct dedicated server exposed one request slot.
ThinkingCap generated substantial reasoning before its client-visible final answer. The profile used 512 retrieval output tokens and 2048 sustained output tokens, and required client-visible content.
A 131K trial with this route became VRAM-tight and sustained decode fell below the useful-speed floor. 64K is the highest useful tier established here, not a maximum-context claim.
